## [1.26.0](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.26.0) (2026-10-10)

### Features

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** support for the latest MovieBox version 4.0.03.0918.03 (versionCode 50020129). The latest release changed its obfuscation scheme, so the patch now locates target methods by the string constants they load and the methods they invoke instead of relying on unstable single-letter method names. Existing custom features (Telegram channel popup, floating support button, download routing) are preserved unchanged.
